description: International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad or popularly called as IIIT H is one of the most coveted colleges for engineering in India. It is often compared to various top NITs and IITs. The institute is located in Gachibowli, Hyderabad. More significantly, this institute is the first IIIT in India. IIIT Hyderabad is mainly focused on the core areas of Information Technology, such as Electronics and Communication, Computer Science and their applications in different domains. | Electronics and Communication Engineering | Computer Science and Engineering |. | Computer Science and Engineering (B.Tech) & Research in Computer Science and Engineering (MS). | Building Science and Engineering (B.Tech) & Research in Building Science and Engineering (MS). | Electronics and Communication Engineering (B.Tech) & Research in Electronics and Communication Engineering (MS). | Computer Science and Engineering – CSE (B.Tech) | 80 |. | BSD – Building Science and Engineering (B.Tech) and Research in Building Science and Engineering (MS) | 15 |.
